hosts.description: SSH aliases of the servers this config deploys to.

auto_update.description: Install the once-per-minute sync cron and prefetch the newest completed tile version

root_redirect_url.description: Optional URL to redirect the tile server root path (/) to. Omit to show a plain text OpenFreeMap tile server message.

cert-upload.description: Upload your own certificate. Ideal for Cloudflare Origin Certificates with 15 year expiry. Steps: 1) Create an Origin Certificate on Cloudflare at SSL/TLS / Origin Server. 2) Generate private key and CSR with Cloudflare: Private key type: ECC, Certificate Validity: 15 years. 3) Key format: PEM. Save origin certificate as something.cert and private key as something.key in the same directory.

cert_path.description: Path to your certificate file (*.cert). Both absolute and relative paths are supported. The corresponding private key (.key) should be in the same directory with the same basename.

cert-letsencrypt.description: Issue and renew certificates with nginx's built-in ACME module. The domain must be publicly reachable on port 80 for HTTP-01 validation.
